verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication tool, not a code host or code-review platform. Reviewing AI agent code diffs and commenting on specific lines is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Basecamp displaying code changes or supporting line-level review comments. Its AI-agent invitations and MCP support concern agents working with Basecamp's to-dos, messages and similar content, not reviewing code.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
